migrations.needle: test('4467各独立有序效果控制未用无负载/PP变化，766多段单位保留公共待确认而不假装验收',()=>{for(const e of H.entries){const s=make(e);s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].pp[key(e.moveId)],H.source.moves.find(m=>m.id===e.moveId).pp);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,9000);}const s=make(pick(766)[0]);s.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;let o=turn(s);H.op(o,31,[2,2],920040);assert.throws(()=>turn(o,920031,920040),/Q-N20-4438-001/);});
migrations.insert: test('4467各有序效果控制未用无负载/PP变化，已答766两段整回合合计不超300',()=>{for(const e of H.entries){const s=make(e);s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;const o=turn(s);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].pp[key(e.moveId)],H.source.moves.find(m=>m.id===e.moveId).pp);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].hp,9000);}const s=make(pick(766)[0]);s.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;let o=turn(s);H.op(o,31,[2,2],920040);timer(o,1,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:200});o=turn(o,920031,920040);assert.equal(o.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack').length,2);assert.equal(sum(o,'attack',0),300);});

migrations.needle: test('4467 834纯反转未扩展4163限定回答，真实反转交互待答而清除/吸取已独立完成',()=>{let s=turn(make(pick(834)[0]));s.fighters[0].stages.atk=1;H.op(s,143,[],920042);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['强化被清封属'].pendingReverseQuestion,'Q-N20-4467-001');assert.throws(()=>turn(s,920031,920042),/Q-N20-4467-001/);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);});
migrations.insert: test('4467已答834精确源纯反转不触发封属，真实+1变-1且不再pending，清除/吸取其它测试保留',()=>{let s=turn(make(pick(834)[0]));s.fighters[0].stages.atk=1;H.op(s,143,[],920042);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['强化被清封属'].triggerOnReverse,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['强化被清封属'].pendingReverseQuestion,undefined);const o=turn(s,920031,920042);assert.equal(o.fighters[0].stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(o.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,undefined);});
